Two merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a `restBaseUrl` line under `src`, both on the main line up to the pinned head (`9777f6d`, PR #683):

It added `handleMutate(\`${restBaseUrl}/stockmanagement/stockrule\`)` and a `restBaseUrl` import in `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-items/add-stock-item/stock-item-rules/add-stock-rules.component.tsx`. Current lines are 17 and 164.
2. **PR #542, "(fix) O3-5648: Wire up stock report submission…"**, merged 2026-05-17 17:28:02 UTC (merge commit `c9d7c101`, ticket O3-5648). It added the `stockitem` and `patient` search URLs built on `restBaseUrl` in `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-reports/generate-report/create-stock-report.workspace.tsx`. Current lines are 189 and 224.

Coverage caveat: I did not search every commit's full diff. I checked the diffs of the candidate PRs and the `restBaseUrl`-bearing files they touched. Excluded after checking: #514, #528, #541, #616, #630 and #683, which changed no `restBaseUrl` line in `src`. In #661, the other restBaseUrl-bearing files changed only `handleMutate` call sites or imports, not the `restBaseUrl` lines themselves. Not inspected at diff level: #552 (jest→vitest, touches test files) and the CSS-only and dependency/CI PRs.
